Project: Kubernetes. Upgrade being assessed: 1.23 -> 1.29.
This change was introduced in release 1.29. Source: Kubernetes Deprecated API Migration Guide (official_deprecation_notice). Section: Removed APIs by release / v1.29 / Flow control resources.
Version facts from package metadata for this release (authoritative for version numbers): none

ITEM:
<<<
Migrate manifests and API clients to use the flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1 API version, available since v1.29, or the flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta3 API version, available since v1.26.
>>>

PARENT CONTEXT (same section, for disambiguation only):
<<<
Removed APIs by release / v1.29 / Flow control resources: The flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 API version of FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration is no longer served as of v1.29. Migrate manifests and API clients to use the flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1 API version, available since v1.29, or the flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta3 API version, available since v1.26. All existing persisted objects are accessible via the new API Notable changes in flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1: * The PriorityLevelConfiguration spec.limited.assuredConcurrencyShares field is renamed to spec.limited.nominalConcurrencyShares and only defaults to 30 when unspecified, and an explicit value of 0 is not changed to 30. Notable changes in flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta3: * The PriorityLevelConfiguration spec.limited.assuredConcurrencyShares field is renamed to spec.limited.nominalConcurrencyShares
>>>

Decide the disposition:
- "risk": the item describes something that can break an app/deployment, require migration work, or create operational risk.
- "context": it is accurate but needs no action at 1.29 (no user action required, deprecated-but-working, additive feature). Give the reason.

For "risk", produce one or more risk paths. Use separate paths for separate symbols/APIs when they can be checked independently. Hard rules:
1. Every condition has at least one quote copied EXACTLY, character for character, from ITEM or PARENT CONTEXT (contiguous span, 3-40 words, no ellipses, no added words). Do not fix typos or formatting.
2. Each path has exactly one condition with category "version" stating that the upgrade crosses release 1.29 (quote the text that ties the change to this release, or the change statement itself), and at least one application/deployment condition (category api_usage, configuration, dependency, runtime, deployment, database, behavior or test_coverage) describing what the app or deployment must use/have for the risk to apply.
3. If the text does not state something you need, do not assert it: use role "uncertain" and explain in ambiguities. derived_by: "extraction" when the text states the fact; for an application/deployment condition ("the application uses X"), use "extraction" when the text names X as the thing affected by the change. Use "inference" only when you infer an affected symbol, scope or impact that the text does not name. Only add ambiguities for real gaps or conflicts in the text, not for the general fact that a specific application has not been inspected.
4. role: "required" (must hold), "alternative" (any one of the alternatives suffices), "optional" (raises impact), "disqualifying" (if it holds, the risk does NOT apply, e.g. not using the new opt-in API), "uncertain".
5. operator/expected_value must be checkable: e.g. operator "present" with expected_value the literal symbol; "less_than" with a version; "equals" with a setting value. expected_value is a string.
6. If a replacement API/setting/version is named, put the migration step in suggested_actions and add a condition for any behavior that differs in the replacement when the text states one.
7. search_queries: for app-side conditions with a literal symbol, give ripgrep regexes (tool "ripgrep"), kubectl commands (tool "kubectl") or SQL (tool "sql") that would find usage. Empty list if no literal symbol.
8. primary_symbol: the most specific identifier of the change (full apiVersion string like "policy/v1beta1", setting name, function, flag, or runtime name like "Python"/"Node.js"). symbols: all identifiers involved.
9. risk_level rubric: critical = upgrade fails or data is at risk for most users meeting the conditions (e.g. unsupported runtime/database version, removed API version that stops serving); high = code or config meeting the conditions breaks at upgrade; medium = behavior change or migration with a clear workaround; low = edge case, cosmetic, or warning-only.
10. fires_at: "upgrade" (at upgrade time), "first_use" (when a feature is first exercised), "rotation" (on credential/password rotation), "rollout" (on deployment rollout), "future_removal" (deprecated now, removed later).
11. applies_to: fill upgrade_method (e.g. "pg_upgrade", "dump/restore"), cluster_type, or from_versions (a version specifier like "<3.1") ONLY if the text restricts applicability; otherwise null.
Do not output confidence.

paths.path_name: flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration no longer served
paths.description: The flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 API version of FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration is no longer served as of v1.29. Manifests and API clients that use v1beta2 must be migrated to flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1 or flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta3.

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses Kubernetes release 1.29, where flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 is no longer served.
quotes: The flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 API version of FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration is no longer served as of v1.29.
conditions.relevance: Ties the removal of the v1beta2 API to release 1.29, which the 1.23 -> 1.29 upgrade crosses.

conditions.statement: Manifests or API clients reference flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 for FlowSchema or PriorityLevelConfiguration.
quotes: The flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 API version of FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration is no longer served as of v1.29.
conditions.relevance: Only manifests and clients that use the removed v1beta2 version are affected.

suggested_actions: Migrate manifests and API clients to flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1 (available since v1.29) or flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta3 (available since v1.26).
If the target is v1 or v1beta3, rename PriorityLevelConfiguration spec.limited.assuredConcurrencyShares to spec.limited.nominalConcurrencyShares.

paths.description: In flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1 and v1beta3, the PriorityLevelConfiguration spec.limited.assuredConcurrencyShares field is renamed to spec.limited.nominalConcurrencyShares. In v1, nominalConcurrencyShares only defaults to 30 when unspecified, and an explicit value of 0 is not changed to 30.

conditions.statement: The upgrade crosses Kubernetes release 1.29, where migration to flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1 becomes available and v1beta2 is no longer served.
quotes: The flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1beta2 API version of FlowSchema and PriorityLevelConfiguration is no longer served as of v1.29.
conditions.relevance: Ties the migration, and the field rename that comes with it, to release 1.29.

conditions.statement: PriorityLevelConfiguration manifests or clients set spec.limited.assuredConcurrencyShares and are migrated to flowcontrol.apiserver.k8s.io/v1 or v1beta3.
quotes: The PriorityLevelConfiguration spec.limited.assuredConcurrencyShares field is renamed to spec.limited.nominalConcurrencyShares
conditions.relevance: The renamed field must be updated when moving to the new API versions.

search_queries.query: kubectl get prioritylevelconfigurations -o yaml | grep -n assuredConcurrencyShares

conditions.statement: PriorityLevelConfiguration sets nominalConcurrencyShares to an explicit value of 0 in v1, where it is no longer changed to 30.
quotes: only defaults to 30 when unspecified, and an explicit value of 0 is not changed to 30.
conditions.relevance: An explicit 0 now stays 0 in v1, which differs from the previous defaulting behavior.
ambiguities: The text does not state the exact earlier behavior for v1beta2 beyond implying that 0 was changed to 30.

suggested_actions: Rename spec.limited.assuredConcurrencyShares to spec.limited.nominalConcurrencyShares when moving manifests to v1 or v1beta3.
Review any PriorityLevelConfiguration with an explicit value of 0, since v1 does not change it to 30.
